primitives.assumptions: Optimism is a conditional response to entropy; human values are bounded by finite time and information.

primitives.name: Anthropocentric Values
primitives.verbatim_quote: We are rather forced to weigh the human environment with human standards of values, and this may well lead us into what for us and for the moment is an optimism.

layer2.telemetry: Observable: value consistency across contexts, optimism resilience.

This implies that while entropy increases, human values can persist within a bounded temporal framework. Shipwreck passengers (SWP) is an isomorphism representing humanity's terminal condition—where planetary doom necessitates a redefinition of agency. Anthropocentric values (AV) assert that value systems are not universal but grounded in human experience. These primitives form a triadic structure: EBO provides the motivational framework, SWP defines the existential boundary, and AV supplies the normative lens. Failure modes include: EBO collapse when entropy exceeds bounds, SWP disintegration when agency vanishes, and AV breakdown when anthropocentrism fails. Each operator exhibits a dual nature: EBO is both a constraint and a motivator; SWP is both a limitation and a call to dignity; AV is both a foundation and a vulnerability.
